selection.method: SHA256 ranking of recording identities; distinct records; median legal grid start per selected bundle.
selection.source: Previously prepared one_per_recording and one_per_bundle inventories, independently cross-checked against the real legal-start index and source metadata.
selection.exclusion: No outcome-based exclusion or selection; previously exposed records may occur.

aggregation: Report clean/noisy separately, per-dataset means and equal dataset macro; one record per case. Expanded development VAL, not a pristine TEST or full-window sweep.
checkpoint: Execution must independently freeze one committed checkpoint and record its SHA256 before any predictions.
